about: Unreal meters (X, Y). rot 0..3: yaw = 90*rot; the mesh front (door) faces +Y at rot 0; mesh origin at the footprint center on the ground. cell = [i, j] of the footprint corner on the 4 m grid counted from origin_m; cells = [w, h] already rotated. floor_cm = flattened ground height. street = side facing the street (same 0..3 as rot), -1 none. entry = [i, j] of the free cell in front of the door (houses). mesh = the Look civil kit mesh. blocks = blocked cells in the simulation. hash = CRC of the simulation fields (the built map has an actor tagged WorldForgeVillage with village_hash:<hash>). Sorted by id; the simulation fields are integers. v3 (13/10): yaw_deg = free yaw (Unreal yaw, degrees) of loose props, wrecks and poles; rot stays the nearest 90 step for older readers. poles = the power poles (piece id, knockable; the crossarm on the mesh local X, wires along local Y; sockets_local = the 4 insulator tips in meters, mesh space). wires = catenaries: a/b = [pole index, socket] or b_wall = [x, y, z] meters on a house wall (b_piece = its id); sag_m = mid-span drop.
